subject: Re: Re-kick: Evaluation MAP and updated close timeline – FinServCo
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ruth Barker <ruth.barker@finservco.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Sep 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan – FinServCo evaluation kickoff

Ruth —

Great to connect last week. Per our call, I’ve attached a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) and a draft SOW so we can align on milestones and owners. High-level goals we agreed on:

- 3-week POC to validate latency and cost profiles for your pricing engine workload
- Security review and SOC-2 evidence collection in parallel
- Executive review and procurement approval by end of Q3

Proposed owners:
- FinServCo: you (Ruth) as champion, + SRE owner for infra tests
- Redwood: me (sales), Nikhil (solutions), Dev (security/eng)

Next steps I suggest:
1) You confirm internal reviewers and target close date (we penciled Sept 26)
2) Nikhil to schedule a 60-min POC kickoff demo (we’ll use the redwood/demo cluster)
3) Dev to start the security questionnaire and share the list of documents we’ll need

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (timeline + owners), SOW_draft.docx

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call if helpful.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0183

From: Ruth Barker <ruth.barker@finservco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 07 Oct 2025 11:07:42 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan – FinServCo evaluation kickoff

Hi Marissa —

Quick update: our Head of Product (champion for this project) left the company last week and we've paused a few procurement tracks while we reorganize. I don't want you to keep blocking cycles with us while we sort owners.

I’ll introduce a replacement once we’ve finalized the new assignment, but that will likely take a few weeks. Can we put an informal hold on the MAP? I still want to run the POC, just need clarity on the internal reviewer set first.

Apologies for the delay — will update as soon as I can.

Best,
Ruth
Director, Platform Engineering
FinServCo

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ruth Barker <ruth.barker@finservco.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 08:32:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Re: Mutual Action Plan – FinServCo evaluation kickoff 

Ruth —

Thanks for the heads-up in October. We’d like to re-open this and propose a short re-kick so we can re-align assumptions and reset the timeline now that hiring/reorgs have settled for your team.

Can I introduce an updated MAP and propose a 6-week timeline that narrows scope to the two core tests you mentioned:
- Accuracy and cost per inference for the pricing engine (walkthrough + 1-week perf run)
- Integration validation for model I/O with your staging APIs (end-to-end smoke)

Proposed updated owners:
- FinServCo champion: Evan Cho (please confirm)
- FinServCo reviewers: SRE, Procurement, IT Security (we’ll add specific names once you confirm)
- Redwood: Marissa (sales), Nikhil (solutions lead), Dev (security lead)

Action items for a quick 30–45 minute MAP re-kick:
1) Evan: confirm you as champion and provide two availability windows for an initial re-kick call
2) FinServCo: confirm which internal person will own procurement paperwork
3) Redwood: we’ll re-share MAP_v2.xlsx with clearer milestones, plus a refreshed SOW_draft.docx

Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx (reduced scope + timeline), SOW_draft.docx (redlines included)

If it helps, Lauren (my manager) is cc’d here — she’ll be on the call to help unblock procurement questions and prioritize resources.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0183

From: Evan Cho <evan.cho@finservco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ruth Barker <ruth.barker@finservco.com>, IT Security <infosec@finservco.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 14:22:10 -0800
Subject: Re: RE: Re: Mutual Action Plan – FinServCo evaluation kickoff

Hi Marissa and team —

Thanks Marissa, and thanks Ruth for the intro. I’m Evan (Sr. Product Manager, FinServCo) and I’ll own this evaluation moving forward. Appreciate the concise MAP — the reduced scope looks good.

A couple quick items from our side:
- Procurement: I’ll confirm the procurement owner (Karen Lee) by EOD Friday
- IT Security: I’ve cc’d infosec to start the SOC-2 checklist conversation; they’ve asked for a 30-min call next week to review evidence requirements
- Timeline: 6-week target works. Can we target a go/no-go review on Dec 19, 2025?

Availability for MAP re-kick call:
- Tue Nov 18, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed Nov 19, 14:00–15:00 PT

DocuSign & paperwork: please re-send the SOW with the updated 6-week schedule (we’ll need it for the procurement packet). Also please provide a DocuSign link for approval-ready docs when available.

Next steps (agreed):
1) Marissa: send MAP_v2.xlsx and updated SOW (DocuSign-ready) — attach doclink + HubSpot record
2) Nikhil/Dev: schedule POC kickoff/demo for Nov 20 if we confirm Tue Nov 18 call
3) Evan/infosec: set 30-min security sync for next week (their availability TBD)

Looking forward to getting this moving.

—
Evan Cho
Senior Product Manager, FinServCo
evan.cho@finservco.com | +1 (415) 555-0199
